title: MessageProvenanceRecord v1 — one fabric message's standing at the provenance door: the message's id, sender, direct target or topic, kind, and per-sender sequence as they stood in the message (null where a malformed message did not carry a usable one), the enrolled signer fingerprint the signature was judged against (null when the sender is not enrolled), the verdict — verified (signed by the enrolled key for the named sender, in sequence) or dropped — and, for a drop, the named reason: unsigned, signature_invalid, unknown_signer, replayed, or malformed; identifiers, names, and counts only, never payload content (Y-059)
